_doc: Claude Code host adapter. `skill_frontmatter` is merged into every packaged SKILL.md; the planning entrypoints stay user-invocable only (contract 5). `reviewer` describes the Claude reviewer child spawned by review.mjs when the author host is Codex (contract 8).
_hooks_doc: Claude Code plugin hooks manifest (packaged as hooks/hooks.json). Every entry runs the shared hook-runner with the hook id; the policy lives in hooks/core/*.mjs and is identical for both hosts. Plugin hooks MERGE with the project's .claude/settings.json hooks — a project that still registers the legacy Bash hooks runs both until it records the replacement (installation.md → Activation). Nothing here is active in any project until the operator installs and trusts the plugin. Native manifests carry only `description` and `hooks`: Codex rejects any other top-level field (observed 2026-09-06: "unknown field `_doc`").
